# Lorebook Model: Developer Reference

## Quick Reference

### Type Definitions (Auto-generated by Prisma)

```typescript
// Individual entry
type LoreEntry = {
  id: number;
  lorebookId: number;
  title: string;
  content: string;
  keys: string; // Space-separated keywords
  constant: boolean; // Always in system prompt?
  enabled: boolean; // Toggle on/off
  priority: number; // Higher = triggered first
  createdAt: Date;
  updatedAt: Date;
};

// Container
type Lorebook = {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  description: string | null;
  createdAt: Date;
  updatedAt: Date;
  entries?: LoreEntry[]; // When included
  characters?: CharacterLorebook[]; // When included
};

// Join table
type CharacterLorebook = {
  id: number;
  characterId: number;
  lorebookId: number;
  character?: Character;
  lorebook?: Lorebook;
};
```

## Common Queries

### Find a character's lorebooks (with entries)

```typescript
import prisma from '@/lib/prisma';

const character = await prisma.character.findUnique({
  where: { id: characterId },
  include: {
    lorebooks: {
      include: {
        lorebook: {
          include: { entries: true }
        }
      }
    }
  }
});

// character.lorebooks[i].lorebook.entries
```

### Find all enabled entries in a lorebook

```typescript
const entries = await prisma.loreEntry.findMany({
  where: {
    lorebookId: lorebookId,
    enabled: true
  },
  orderBy: { priority: 'desc' } // Highest priority first
});
```

### Create a new lorebook with entries

```typescript
const lorebook = await prisma.lorebook.create({
  data: {
    name: 'My World',
    description: 'Geography and factions',
    entries: {
      createMany: {
        data: [
          {
            title: 'The Red Guard',
            content: 'A military order known for...',
            keys: 'red guard soldiers knights',
            constant: false,
            priority: 100
          },
          {
            title: 'The Capital',
            content: 'The largest city, built on...',
            keys: 'capital city throne palace',
            constant: true, // Always send
            priority: 90
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
});
```

### Link a lorebook to a character

```typescript
await prisma.characterLorebook.create({
  data: {
    characterId: charId,
    lorebookId: lorebookId
  }
});

// Or via character (bulk):
await prisma.character.update({
  where: { id: charId },
  data: {
    lorebooks: {
      create: [
        { lorebookId: lorebookId1 },
        { lorebookId: lorebookId2 }
      ]
    }
  }
});
```

### Delete a lorebook (cascades to entries + links)

```typescript
await prisma.lorebook.delete({
  where: { id: lorebookId }
});
// Automatically:
// - Deletes all LoreEntry rows for this lorebook
// - Deletes all CharacterLorebook rows for this lorebook
```

## Keyword Matching (Application Logic, Not DB)

Keywords are stored as space-separated strings. When processing a chat request:

```typescript
function extractKeywords(entryKeysString: string): string[] {
  return entryKeysString
    .toLowerCase()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(k => k.length > 0);
}

function hasKeywordMatch(
  text: string,
  keywords: string[]
): boolean {
  const lowerText = text.toLowerCase();
  // Whole-word match only (regex word boundaries)
  return keywords.some(kw => new RegExp(`\\b${kw}\\b`).test(lowerText));
}

// Example
const entry = await prisma.loreEntry.findUnique({ where: { id: 1 } });
const keywords = extractKeywords(entry.keys);
const messageText = "The red guard arrived at dawn.";
const triggered = hasKeywordMatch(messageText, keywords);
// true (because "red" and "guard" are in the entry's keys)
```

## Performance Notes

- `lore_entries.lorebookId` has an index for fast lookups
- `character_lorebooks(characterId, lorebookId)` is unique, no duplicates
- `lorebooks.name` is unique for easy lookups
- Queries with `include` should be paginated if lorebooks have many entries
- Keyword matching happens in application code, not DB (simpler logic)

## Validation Rules

| Field | Rules |
|-------|-------|
| `lorebook.name` | Unique, required |
| `loreEntry.keys` | Text, space-separated, any length (parsed in app) |
| `loreEntry.priority` | Integer 0–200 (conventionally; no DB constraint) |
| `loreEntry.constant` | Boolean; true means always in system prompt |
| `loreEntry.enabled` | Toggle; when false, entry is skipped entirely |

## Export/Import Considerations

When exporting a database, include:

```json
{
  "lorebooks": [
    { "id": 1, "name": "World A", "description": "..." }
  ],
  "loreEntries": [
    { "id": 1, "lorebookId": 1, "title": "...", "content": "...", "keys": "..." }
  ],
  "characterLorebooks": [
    { "id": 1, "characterId": 5, "lorebookId": 1 }
  ],
  "characters": [
    { "id": 5, "name": "Char1", ..., "_loreIds": [1] }
  ]
}
```

When importing:
1. Create Lorebooks (map old ID → new ID)
2. Create LoreEntries (update lorebookId references)
3. Create CharacterLorebook joins (update both ID references)
